name: Junior Tafa
summary: A New Zealand heavyweight/light heavyweight from NTG (7-6, age 30), 3-6 in the UFC. He knocked out Kevin Christian (R1) in May, then was knocked out by Iwo Baraniewski (R1) in June.

how_they_fight.Striking: A kickboxer with power: all seven wins are knockouts (five in R1).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Weak: submitted three times (Walker R1, Tokkos R2, Elekana R2).
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped five times, two of them by knockout.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fades when the fight goes to the ground.

concerns: Lost five of his last seven
keys_to_beat: Take him down: three submission losses
